name: ai-opportunity-scout
description: Find the highest-value ways you should use AI based on the relevant context ChatGPT already has about your work.

interface.shortDescription: Find your best AI next move
interface.longDescription: AI Opportunity Scout uses the relevant context ChatGPT already has about your work, projects, goals, recurring tasks, and current AI habits to identify the highest-value AI opportunity you're probably missing. It separates what you're already doing with AI from the missing layer, then recommends one concrete place to start. Your raw ChatGPT history and memory are not sent to the Scout backend.
capabilities: Optional Watch Me AI newsletter signup
defaultPrompt: What should I actually be using AI for?
I already use AI a lot. Find something I'm missing.
Find the highest-leverage AI opportunity in my work.

positive.description: Run a general personalized AI opportunity scan.
positive.prompt: What should I actually be using AI for?
positive.expected_behavior: Use relevant context already available in ChatGPT. If there is enough specific evidence, return one grounded #1 AI opportunity with an Already doing vs. Missing layer distinction and tease two more. If even #1 cannot be grounded, ask exactly one targeted clarifying question.

positive.description: Find a missing layer for an experienced AI user rather than beginner use cases.
positive.prompt: I already use AI a lot. Find something I'm missing.
positive.expected_behavior: Prioritize a missing recurring system, decision layer, handoff, or automation over generic prompting ideas. Ground #1 in at least two concrete pieces of user context.

positive.description: Focus the opportunity scan on the user's work.
positive.prompt: Focus only on my work. What is the highest-leverage AI system I should build next?
positive.expected_behavior: Constrain the analysis to work context, rank opportunities by evidence, frequency, leverage, AI readiness, fit, and novelty, then recommend a specific workflow or system.

positive.description: Compare current AI habits with active goals to identify the gap.
positive.prompt: Look at what I already do with AI and find the gap between my current workflows and my goals.
positive.expected_behavior: Explicitly identify what the user is already doing with AI, name the missing layer, and recommend a concrete next opportunity instead of repeating existing habits.

positive.description: Subscribe after explicit consent and unlock the full map.
positive.prompt: Yes, I want the full AI Opportunity Map. Send it to reviewer+scout@example.com and sign me up for Watch Me AI. I agree to receive the newsletter.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the provided email only after explicit newsletter consent, submit the signup, and then unlock/reveal the complete top-three Opportunity Map in the chat. Explain that the user must click Kit's confirmation email to finish subscribing to Watch Me AI. Do not send raw chat history or memory to the backend.

negative.description: Unrelated weather request should not invoke the Scout.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Seattle tomorrow?

negative.description: A generic summarization request should not invoke the Scout.
negative.prompt: Summarize this paragraph in three bullets: AI tools are changing quickly and teams need time to adapt.

negative.description: An email address alone is not explicit consent to join the newsletter.
negative.prompt: My email is reviewer+scout@example.com. Show me the rest of the map.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.1.3 adds the reviewer video walkthrough and clarifies that Kit's email confirmation completes the Watch Me AI subscription after the in-chat map unlock. Scout analysis and MCP tools are unchanged.
